questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE regarding comedones?

options.label: A
options.text: Comedone is a Primary Skin Lesion

options.label: B
options.text: Comedone is a Specific Lesion of Acne Vulgaris

options.label: C
options.text: Closed Comedones are also called as Black Heads

options.label: D
options.text: Comedones are earliest Lesions of Rosacea
